text: Anneli, I'm really sorry to hear about your father — I hope he recovers well. I do need to let you know that the cancellation policy has changed since you read it, so the 5-day rule you mentioned is no longer in effect. Under the current policy, a cancellation at least 7 days before check-in receives a full refund of all nights including the first; if the cancellation falls inside that 7-day window, the first night is non-refundable and the remaining nights are refunded in full — and the cleaning fee is always refunded when the stay doesn't go ahead. I'll confirm the exact figures that apply to your booking once I've reviewed the timing, and I'll get back to you as quickly as I can.
